title: r37#5 非脸部裁切候选的“用这张”

steps.clickAt: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button.hub-face-img')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('data-crop')==='no'); const card=b.closest('figure, li, .hub-face, div'); let c=b.parentElement; let u=null; for(let i=0;i<4&&c&&!u;i++,c=c.parentElement){ u=[...c.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/用这张/.test(x.innerText)); } if(!u) return [null,null]; u.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=u.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/2]; })()
